scope.description: Generalize the validated PYTHON_V2_DESCRIPTIVE_REGIONAL C++/HTSlib endpoint from HCC1395 to the frozen seven-dataset production authority, run all seven autosomal datasets with 24 workers, independently validate and freeze every run, compare only against available frozen Python authorities, and publish a cross-dataset timing and result report.

assumptions: The exact dataset order is HCC1395, HCC1395_DORADO, COLO829, H1437, H2009, HCC1937 and HCC1954, as frozen in oracle/production_input_authority.json.
The endpoint remains descriptive/evaluation-only and does not replace formal M2/topology or promote P7.

Every run uses a raw BAM, the same-run LongPhase-S recalibrated PASS biallelic sSNV VCF, the latest truth-free HP/PS sidecar and the matching GRCh38 reference; persisted truth-tagged BAM and truth BED/VCF remain forbidden.

A sample is called Python-parity-verified only when a frozen Python output with exact membership keys and digests is available; otherwise only C++ execution, schema, determinism and validator evidence may be claimed.
Runs are sequential at 24 workers by default to avoid oversubscribing the shared NFS mount; this may be revised only after a recorded resource preflight.

deviations: The first broad-search-induced host load incident was isolated to eight stale read-only rg/find processes; only those exact PIDs were terminated, no science process or root service was touched, and subsequent queries remained path-targeted.

The raw-BAM authority scan began sequentially. After telemetry showed about 95% CPU idle, about 2% I/O wait and load near 3, only the final three one-time SHA scans were changed to three-way nice/ionice execution with canonical-path and before/after identity gates. Seven-sample science remains sequential across samples and 24-worker within each sample.

The first independent raw-hash receipt verification attempt was rejected before execution because the temporary verifier lacked an executable bit; no output or partial was created. After chmod 0755, the same immutable inputs produced a 6/6 PASS receipt. A later naive text scan also matched the required policy keys truth_fields=0 and persisted_tagged_bam_allowed=false; the artifact was not changed, and the corrected semantic closed-shape replay passed.

The completed v1 seven-sample science batch froze all seven bundles, but the first exact crosswalk failed closed at one H2009 unit because bounded_binomial compared an undivided intermediate product with the 150000 budget. C(45,4)=148995 was falsely capped. The immutable v1 attempt is retained as failed evidence; the solver and an exact H2009 regression are in scope, and a new v2 seven-sample batch is required rather than rewriting frozen artifacts.

During the v2 DORADO run, eleven unrelated broad rg/find searches from another session raised load1 to 87.5, blocked tasks to 97 and I/O wait to 84%. The v2 outer scheduler and DORADO producer were reversibly SIGSTOPed at 02:08:22; after the searches remained active for about 15 minutes and violated the user's no-broad-search constraint, only those exact read-only search PIDs received SIGTERM. No science, validator, service or agent process was terminated. Blocked tasks immediately fell to zero; DORADO resumed at 02:14:39 and froze successfully. Its reported science wall includes the 377-second pause and is excluded from strict timing comparison.

The v2 scheduler was paused after an input-form interpretation diverged from the locked raw-BAM-plus-exact-sidecar production contract. The restricted external receipt remains in the run root, but its absolute path was removed from this Git task registry because repository evidence paths must be sanitized and relative.

Two report-source evidence rows were removed after repository sanitization changed the presentation source bytes. Their 2026-07-21 executions do not attest the sanitized source; current-source compile and presentation QA must be recorded by the superseding 20260722 repair task.

The superseding publication repair rebuilt the HCC1395 baseline report from the same frozen receipts after removing a redundant Markdown H1 and adding an explicit descriptive/non-production PARTIAL ribbon. The active task input digest now binds that presentation-only successor; scientific datasets and claims are unchanged.

On 2026-07-22 the superseded stopped v2 scheduler process group 3977781 was terminated by exact process-group identity and then continued only so stopped children could observe SIGTERM. The process group was confirmed empty afterward. No run was resumed, no frozen artifact was rewritten, and any future continuation requires a fresh governed run root and immutable input authority.

The publication repair regenerated the same HCC1395 presentation model after narrowing the performance heading from an apparent speed claim to an explicitly uncontrolled shorter-wall-time observation, labeling the crosswalk as not independently frozen, and adding the literal PARTIAL ribbon token.
